strings.en: I’d like to have another Pokémon battle{NEWLINE}with you sometime. Can we trade{CLEAR}phone numbers? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我们离得这么近{NEWLINE}干嘛还用电话聊天,{SCROLL}你别害羞啊,{NEWLINE}直接来找我聊天好了。
strings.en: We’re this close, so why talk on the{NEWLINE}phone? Don’t be shy.{SCROLL}Just come talk to me in person.

strings.zh: 有些人不给自己{NEWLINE}钓到的精灵喂食,{CLEAR}但我绝不会这么做的。{SCROLL}不管怎么说,我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}一直都那么努力,{SCROLL}我要给它好吃的东西,{NEWLINE}抚养它,轻抚它,怜爱它,{CLEAR}好好珍惜它！
strings.en: Some people never feed the Pokémon{NEWLINE}they fish up, but I’d never do that.{SCROLL}After all, my {VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}always works so hard.{SCROLL}So I feed it tasty things,{NEWLINE}groom it, pet it, show it{CLEAR}affection, and just cherish it!

strings.zh: 昨天我也去钓鱼了,{NEWLINE}还打败了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}虽然我知道如果去{NEWLINE}山上,森林里,{CLEAR}草原上,洞窟里{CLEAR}看看的话能找到{CLEAR}更多的精灵,{SCROLL}但我还是更喜欢像{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}那样的精灵。
strings.en: Yesterday I went fishing and knocked{NEWLINE}out a {VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}I know that if I go to the mountains, or{NEWLINE}the forest, or the grassland, or the{CLEAR}caves, or any place like that,{CLEAR}I could find all kinds of Pokémon.{SCROLL}But I just really like Pokémon like{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}, you know...

strings.zh: 被精灵逃掉了真是可惜！{NEWLINE}前几天就在最后关头被{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}给逃掉了,{CLEAR}真是的太可惜了。{SCROLL}你在钓鱼的时候,{NEWLINE}也要全神贯注的,{CLEAR}不要给自己留下后悔的机会！
strings.en: It’s such a shame when a Pokémon{NEWLINE}gets away! Just the other day, a{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11} got away at the last{CLEAR}second. I was so disappointed.{SCROLL}When you’re fishing, give it your{NEWLINE}full concentration, so you don’t{CLEAR}leave yourself any regrets!

strings.zh: 我钓鱼都钓腻了,{NEWLINE}差不多该和你再来一场对战了！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: I’m getting sick of fishing. I’d rather{NEWLINE}have a Pokémon battle with you!{SCROLL}Hey! I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 喂喂,我们约好了在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}对战的啊！{CLEAR}快点过来！
strings.en: Hello? We made plans to meet on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} for a battle, right?{CLEAR}Hey! Hurry up and get here.

strings.zh: 垂钓的乐趣,{NEWLINE}在于你提竿之前,{CLEAR}根本不知道{CLEAR}会出现什么。{SCROLL}我还幻想{NEWLINE}有一天能够钓到{CLEAR}传说中的精灵呢。{SCROLL}不过这个可能性{NEWLINE}差不多是０吧？{SCROLL}比如雷公什么的。{NEWLINE}我在各地巡回的时候{CLEAR}可能会一个不小心{CLEAR}掉到海里去。{SCROLL}那个雷公或许也有一天{NEWLINE}掉进海里去的吧？{SCROLL}⋯⋯好像扯了一点。
strings.en: The fun of fishing is not knowing what{NEWLINE}you’ll get until you reel it in.{SCROLL}I even daydream about fishing up a{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon someday.{SCROLL}But the chances of that are basically{NEWLINE}zero, right? Like Raikou, for example.{SCROLL}When I travel around, I might slip and{NEWLINE}fall into the sea by accident.{SCROLL}Maybe that Raikou will fall into the sea{NEWLINE}one day, too? ...I guess that’s a bit of{CLEAR}a stretch.
